owner_phone_requires_consent.name: owner_phone_requires_consent
owner_phone_requires_consent.value: "businesses"."owner_phone" is null or "businesses"."owner_contact_consent_ref" is not null

phone_requires_consent.name: phone_requires_consent
phone_requires_consent.value:
("customers"."phone" is null and "customers"."normalized_phone" is null) or (
        "customers"."consent_method" is not null and "customers"."consent_wording_version" is not null and
        "customers"."consent_at" is not null and "customers"."consent_evidence_ref" is not null and "customers"."attestation_id" is not null)

has_contact.name: has_contact
has_contact.value: "customers"."phone" is not null or "customers"."email" is not null

approved_requires_session.name: approved_requires_session
approved_requires_session.value: "reply_drafts"."approved_at" is null or "reply_drafts"."approved_session_id" is not null

posted_requires_approval.name: posted_requires_approval
posted_requires_approval.value: "reply_drafts"."posted_at" is null or "reply_drafts"."approved_at" is not null
